description: Text your customers without leaving ChatGPT. Salesmsg connects your business texting inbox directly to your AI assistant - so you can send messages, read conversation threads, find or create contacts, and check reply history in seconds. Whether you're following up on a lead, responding to an unread thread, or starting a conversation with a new contact, ChatGPT handles it all through your real Salesmsg numbers. Simple to connect. Instant to text.
